understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through every level by moving each selectable piece onto a '+' goal tile; all goals in a level must be occupied simultaneously to win the level and complete the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one 3-pixel grid cell per directional action when unobstructed. Adjacent pushable blocks can be moved by pushing, while walls or boundaries may block movement. Multiple selectable pieces can be switched using CLICK with their pixel coordinates; movement affects only the currently selected piece. Movement hints indicate nearby objects but are not always definitive.
